Triage: **promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`**, routed **`domain:devx`** (fix lands in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` and/or `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — gate-class scripts and internal PM tooling; same-file precedent #7412 already sits in `domain:devx`).

Why promoted rather than held: this is not dormant — the H2 sweep output is consumed by seats on live patrols today, and the false positive fires on every sweep against #6752's documented-shape claim. Both anchors re-verified on `origin/main` @ `7e93c89d`: the step-4 claim template is a blockquote (`> Claim: …`, SKILL.md ~:1492-1498) and `h2AssigneeNoClaimComment`'s regex `/^\s*Claim(?:ed)?\s*[::]/mi` (check-half-states.mjs:87) cannot match a `>`-prefixed line — the mismatch is real and will grow as more seats adopt the documented shape.

The direction choice (relax the predicate vs change the template) is a dev-level tooling call, not a product ruling — the card's own measure-first instruction (count already-posted claims in each form before choosing) plus its regex-width warning are the dispatch constraints. ⚠️ Dispatcher note: per the card, the 2026-08-10 model-tier policy applies (PM-skill-touching card).

Dup check: #7412 is the same file but a different defect (sweep cannot run in a PM session / docblob over-promise) — neighbours, not duplicates; cross-linked here. No other open card mentions `check-half-states` or the H2 predicate.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

The required fleet measurement was run and SUPPORTS direction 1 (2 blockquote claims would be orphaned by direction 2; relaxing orphans nothing) — and it surfaced a real correction to this card's own body: the "other seven carry no claim comment in any form" sentence is wrong (all seven carry claims in two spellings the predicate never measured). That correction is properly recorded here and filed as **#7553** with both directions written out — a protocol ruling, deliberately NOT implemented in this PR per this card's own regex-width bar. Good run: the card was obeyed where it ruled and falsified where it generalized.

The declared tooling limitation (live sweep's fetch half cannot run in-container, 403 on `api.github.com/repos/**` — re-confirming #7412) is stated plainly with fixtures carrying real API-read lines; the predicate half ran unmodified in both directions. Acceptable verification for a report-only tool.

Landing: flipping ready + arming auto-merge now (queue path).
